worldcombat.skill.kinesis.summary: Bends a spoon on the spot to draw the attention of one foe that can see it: its accuracy drops and its blows weaken. The range is the longest of the family, but any cover makes the trick fizzle.
worldcombat.skill.kinesis.use.0: Name the nastiest foe from a distance
worldcombat.skill.kinesis.use.2: Win a duel or cover a retreat with a single-target edge
worldcombat.skill.kinesis.description.0: A beguiled target strikes weaker, and a Pokemon also loses %1$s accuracy stage(s), for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.kinesis.description.1: The gaze reaches %1$s blocks; it affects one target only and never spreads.
worldcombat.skill.kinesis.description.2: Raising the spoon takes %1$s with a %2$s cooldown. Line of sight is required: a wall, pillar or other cover in the way makes the trick fizzle.
worldcombat.skill.kinesis.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.kinesis.preference.ben: Twist: +1 beguile stage and x1.4 duration, at +6 ticks wind-up and x1.2 cooldown; Snap: a faster, cheaper cast at the base stage and duration.
The companion only considers the trick while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it close, larger names foes from across the field.
Targeting bends only while the enemy attacks the companion or its owner, or right after a hit; Anytime bends at any threat.
When on, the companion may leave its post to bend the spoon under a Hold order.
